operations.label: Authenticate to ACT CRM
operations.summary: requireLogin → loginToACTCrm; ctx.page('crm') waits for the authenticated CRM browser page to be ready in the session pool

operations.label: Login to ACT CRM (Salesforce SSO)
operations.summary: requireLogin(loginToACTCrm, 'CRM authentication failed') — navigates to act-crm.my.site.com, fills SSO credentials, awaits MFA if required

operations.label: Wait for UCPath Entry Sheet section to load
operations.summary: page.waitForLoadState('networkidle', { timeout: 15_000 })

operations.label: Navigate to UCPath Entry Sheet section (URL fast path)
operations.note: recordId extracted from current page URL searchParams.get('id'). Fast path when CRM_SECTION_URLS has 'UCPath Entry Sheet'. Falls through to sectionNav.byName click when fast path unavailable.

operations.label: Scrape address
operations.summary: extractField with labels ['Address Line 1', 'Address', 'Street Address']

operations.label: Scrape appointment number
operations.summary: extractField with labels ['Appointment', 'Appointment Number', 'Appt']; extracts trailing digit e.g. 'Casual/Restricted 5' → '5'

operations.label: Scrape city
operations.summary: extractField with labels ['City']

operations.label: Scrape department number from CRM record page (ONB_ViewOnboarding)
operations.summary: extractField with label variants ['Department', 'Department Name', 'Dept']; parseDepartmentNumber extracts parenthesized code e.g. 'Computer Science (000412)' → '000412'
operations.note: Must be called AFTER selectLatestResult and BEFORE navigateToSection('UCPath Entry Sheet')

operations.label: Scrape date of birth
operations.summary: extractField with labels ['Date of Birth', 'DOB', 'Birth Date']

operations.label: Scrape effective date / first day of service
operations.summary: extractField with labels ['First Day of Service (Effective Date)', 'First Day of Service', 'Effective Date', 'Start Date']

operations.label: Scrape personal email
operations.summary: extractField with labels ['Email', 'Email Address', 'Personal Email']

operations.label: Scrape first name
operations.summary: extractField with labels ['First Name', 'Legal First Name']

operations.label: Scrape last name
operations.summary: extractField with labels ['Last Name', 'Legal Last Name']

operations.label: Scrape middle name
operations.summary: extractField with labels ['Middle Name', 'Middle Initial']

operations.label: Scrape phone number
operations.summary: extractField with labels ['Cell Phone', 'Mobile Phone', 'Phone', 'Phone Number']

operations.label: Scrape position number
operations.summary: extractField with labels ['Position Number', 'Position #', 'Position No']

operations.label: Scrape postal code
operations.summary: extractField with labels ['Postal Code', 'Zip Code', 'ZIP']

operations.label: Scrape recruitment number from CRM record page
operations.summary: extractField with label variants ['Recruitment Number', 'Recruitment #', 'Recruitment No', 'Req Number']

operations.label: Scrape SSN
operations.summary: extractField with labels ['SSN (National ID)', 'SSN', 'Social Security Number']

operations.label: Scrape state
operations.summary: extractField with labels ['State']

operations.label: Scrape wage / compensation rate
operations.summary: extractField with labels ['Compensation rate', 'Compensation Rate', 'Wage', 'Pay Rate']

operations.label: Skip re-download if all requested PDFs already exist on disk
operations.summary: existsSync(folderPath) → readdirSync matches ^Doc<N>-.+\.pdf$ for every requested index. Returns early with found list if all present.
operations.note: Guard against re-running a partially-complete download step.

operations.label: Fetch onboarding documents via direct HTTP GET (doc indices 0 and 2)
operations.summary: page.context().request.get('/iDocsForSalesforceDocumentServer?i=N&h=hash') for DEFAULT_CRM_DOC_INDICES [0, 2]; writes bytes to local folder path; stamps pdfDownload count and pdfFolder on row data
operations.note: Non-fatal: catch block stamps pdfDownload:'Failed:...' and continues to UCPath/I9 phases without interruption

operations.label: HTTP GET each requested document from iDocs document server
operations.summary: page.context().request.get(url) for each docIndex in input.docIndices (default [0, 2]). Serial loop; skips indices >= totalDocs with log.error.

operations.label: Assert iDocs response is OK and is a valid PDF
operations.summary: response.ok() must be true. isCrmPdfResponse: rejects HTML (prefix check); accepts application/pdf content-type OR PDF magic bytes (%PDF-). Throws on failure.

operations.label: Wait for iDocs PDF.js viewer iframe and extract document hash
operations.summary: Polls page.frames() every 500ms up to 30s for a frame at crickportal-ext.bfs.ucsd.edu/iDocsForSalesforce/Content/pdfjs/web/PDFjsViewer.aspx. Extracts h= (hash) and c= (totalDocs) from iframe URL query params.
operations.note: hash is required for the document-server fetch URL. totalDocs used to skip out-of-range index requests.

operations.label: Navigate to iDocs PDF.js viewer to extract hash and doc count
operations.summary: downloadCrmIdocsDocuments navigates to the PDF.js viewer URL embedded in the CRM page; extracts h (hash) and totalDocs count from viewer URL query params

operations.label: Wait for employee record page to load fully
operations.summary: waitForLoadState('domcontentloaded', timeout=15s) then waitForLoadState('networkidle', timeout=15s)

operations.label: Extract Appointment End Date from CRM record
operations.note: extractField('Appointment (Expected Job) End Date') with fallback to 'Appointment End Date'

operations.label: Extract name fields — strategy 3: th OR td label → following td (broader fallback, UNVERIFIED)
operations.summary: Visualforce label → value strategy 3: label in any cell (<th> OR <td>) via .or() chain, value in next sibling <td>.
operations.note: Added 2026-06-07; UNVERIFIED against live CRM DOM. .or() chain combining strategies 1+2 in one locator pass. Strictly additive — can only find MORE values, never break a working extract.

operations.label: Extract Date Signed (oath date) from CRM record
operations.note: extractField('Date Signed'); used for oathDate in crm-dates step when includeCrmDates:true

operations.label: Extract Date Signed for date enrichment
operations.note: extractField('Date Signed'); the oath taken-and-subscribed date; stamped as oathDate

operations.label: Extract Department from CRM record
operations.note: extractField('Department'); used in CrmRecord shape; surfaced in crm-only path to set ctx.data.department

operations.label: Extract First Day of Service (Effective Date) from CRM record
operations.note: extractField('First Day of Service (Effective Date)') with fallback to 'First Day of Service'; becomes the operator-facing startDate via pickCrmStartDate(records, emplId)

operations.label: Extract First Day of Service for date enrichment
operations.note: extractField('First Day of Service (Effective Date)'); record selection prefers EID-matched record (ctx.data.emplId); falls back to first record; stamped as employmentDate

operations.label: Extract Employee First Name from CRM record
operations.note: extractField('Employee First Name') via strategy chain: record.thLabelFollowingTd → record.tdLabelFollowingTd → record.cellLabelFollowingTd → record.rowLabelLastCell → record.lightningFieldValue; 500ms timeout per strategy variant

operations.label: Extract Hire Type from CRM record
operations.note: extractField('Hire Type')

operations.label: Extract Employee Last Name from CRM record
operations.note: extractField('Employee Last Name'); combined with firstName as 'lastName, firstName'

operations.label: Extract name fields — strategy 5: Salesforce Lightning slds-form-element (UNVERIFIED)
operations.summary: Salesforce Lightning record-detail fallback: reads .slds-form-element__control for a matching .slds-form-element__label.
operations.note: Added 2026-06-07; UNVERIFIED. .slds-form-element:has(.slds-form-element__label:has-text(label)) .slds-form-element__control. Catches CRM record pages served by Lightning UI instead of classic Visualforce.

operations.label: Extract Personal Email Address from CRM record
operations.note: extractField('Personal Email Address')

operations.label: Extract PPS ID from CRM record
operations.note: extractField('PPS ID')

operations.label: Extract name fields — strategy 4: row containing label → last td (row-scoped fallback, UNVERIFIED)
operations.summary: Visualforce label → value strategy 4: finds <tr> containing the label, reads its last <td> — robust when extra spacer cells separate label from value.
operations.note: Added 2026-06-07; UNVERIFIED. tr:has-text(label) → td:last-child. Handles value not in immediate sibling td. stripLabel removes label prefix from extracted text.

operations.label: Extract name fields — strategy 2: td label → following td (Visualforce fallback, verified 2026-04-14)
operations.summary: Visualforce label → value strategy 2 (fallback): label in <td>, value in the next sibling <td>.
operations.note: Fallback when strategy 1 misses for a field. Same label sets and 500ms timeout.

operations.label: Extract name fields — strategy 1: th label → following td (Visualforce, verified 2026-04-14)
operations.summary: Visualforce label → value strategy 1: label in <th>, value in the next sibling <td>.
operations.note: Tried first for all four name fields. Labels: firstName=['First Name','Legal First Name'], lastName=['Last Name','Legal Last Name'], middleName=['Middle Name','Middle Initial'], livedName=['Lived Name','Lived First Name','Preferred Name','Preferred First Name']. 500ms timeout per attempt; first hit wins, remaining strategies skipped for that field.

operations.label: Extract Title Code/Payroll Title from CRM record
operations.note: extractField('Title Code/Payroll Title'); payrollTitleFromTitleCode strips leading code prefix ('4921 - STDT 2' → 'STDT 2') via pickCrmPayrollTitle

operations.label: Extract UCPath Employee ID from CRM record
operations.note: extractField('UCPath Employee ID'); key field for EID-path record selection and for direct-match in matchCrmEid

operations.label: Extract UCSD Email Address from CRM record
operations.note: extractField('UCSD Email Address')

operations.label: Navigate to CRM record page
operations.note: Navigates to each matching row's recordUrl (absolute URL or prefixed with https://act-crm.my.site.com); waitUntil:domcontentloaded + networkidle

operations.label: Navigate to CRM record page for date extraction
operations.note: Same extractCrmRecord flow as cross-verification; all 12 fields extracted, but only firstDayOfService and dateSigned are stamped as outputs

operations.label: Write PDF bytes to disk and register in tracker
operations.summary: Filename = Doc<N>-<sanitized>.pdf. Name source priority: Content-Disposition header → CRM_DOC_DEFAULT_NAMES[idx] ('Signed Offer Letter' idx 0 / 'EE Data Gathering Form' idx 2) → 'document-N'. writeFile(savedPath, body). tryRegisterDownloadedFile({kind:'crm-document'}).
operations.note: savedCount accumulates across indices; used in archive step to populate pdfDownload detail field.

operations.label: Wait for network idle after search navigation
operations.summary: page.waitForLoadState('networkidle', { timeout: 15_000 })

operations.label: Navigate to CRM search URL with email query param
operations.note: query = input.email if present, else input.emplId. Direct URL navigation (faster than search-input UI). waitUntil='domcontentloaded', timeout=15s. ctx.retry attempts=3.
operations.summary: searchByEmail → searchCrmOnboardingRecords → page.goto(CRM_SEARCH_URL?q=email); waitUntil domcontentloaded + networkidle

operations.label: Click name link (first td > a) of latest-dated result row
operations.note: Primary: nthResultRow(page, latestIndex).locator('td').first().locator('a') via clickIfPresent. Fallback: safeClick on the first td cell directly. ctx.retry attempts=3.
operations.summary: clickIfPresent on nameLink (td.first().locator('a')); fallback clicks td.first() directly; waits domcontentloaded + networkidle

operations.label: Scrape 'Offer Sent On' date from each result row to identify latest
operations.summary: Nth result row; use .locator('td').nth(1) for the 'Offer Sent On' column (index 1).
operations.note: Compound: nthResultRow(page, i).locator('td').nth(1) for column index 1. Iterates all rows; parses each date with new Date(); latestIndex = row with most recent date. Silently skips unparseable dates; throws 'CRM returned search rows but no parsable Offer Sent On date' if no valid date found.

operations.label: Assert at least one result row exists
operations.summary: rows.count() === 0 → throw ExtractionError('No search results found')

operations.label: Scrape result rows to pick latest by Offer Sent On date
operations.summary: Count rows; read column 1 (Offer Sent On date) from each nthResultRow; select row index with latest parseable date; throws ExtractionError if 0 rows or all dates unparseable

operations.label: Wait for CRM search results to load
operations.summary: waitForLoadState('domcontentloaded', 15s) + waitForLoadState('networkidle', 15s) — catch on networkidle

operations.label: Wait for CRM search results (dates)
operations.summary: waitForLoadState('networkidle', 15s) — graceful catch

operations.label: Scrape CRM search result rows
operations.note: Inline locator 'table tbody tr' (not a registry selector); count cells safely to handle rows with fewer than 5 columns; extracts name (cell[0].textContent), offerSentOn (cell[1]), processStage (cell[4]), recordUrl from cell[0] anchor href

operations.label: Scrape CRM search result rows for date enrichment
operations.note: Inline 'table tbody tr' scrape; same extraction as cross-verification; filters by name tokens

operations.label: Navigate to CRM search with query
operations.note: EID path: query = emplId (precise); name path: query iterates buildCrmNameSearchQueries(lastName, firstName) — lastName first, then firstName, then individual tokens; stops at first query that yields name-token-matching rows

operations.label: Navigate to CRM search for date enrichment
operations.note: searchCrmByName using the resolved ctx.data.searchName parsed via parsePersonOrgNameInput; same multi-query strategy as cross-verification name path

operations.label: Fallback: click UCPath Entry Sheet section nav element
operations.summary: Click a named CRM section via a fallback chain: link → plain text → tab.
operations.note: 3-deep .or() chain: getByRole('link',{name:/UCPath Entry Sheet/i}) | getByText('UCPath Entry Sheet') | getByRole('tab',{name:/UCPath Entry Sheet/i}). Only called when direct URL nav is unavailable (recordId missing or section not in CRM_SECTION_URLS).

operations.label: Navigate to UCPath Entry Sheet section
operations.summary: navigateToSection(page, 'UCPath Entry Sheet'): fast path via CRM_SECTION_URLS direct URL with ?id=recordId when section URL known; fallback clicks sectionNav.byName(page, sectionName).first(); waits networkidle

operations.label: ACT CRM SSO login (kernel-managed)
operations.summary: requireLogin(loginToACTCrm, 'ACT CRM authentication failed') — kernel prepends auth step when authSteps: true; Duo MFA auto-cleared by duo-autopilot extension
operations.note: loginToACTCrm defined in src/infra/auth/login.ts. No handler-visible selectors — kernel owns the auth page interactions.

operations.label: Stamp CRM-sourced fields and capture screenshot
operations.summary: ctx.updateData({ crmMatch, crmMatchedEmplId?, startDate, payrollTitle }); stampCrmStartDateAndScreenshot: ctx.captureAndStampScreenshot('crm-record', 'crmRecordScreenshot') on found record, or 'crmSearchScreenshot' on no-record / error

operations.label: Stamp CRM date fields onto tracker row
operations.summary: ctx.updateData({ employmentDate, oathDate }); best-effort — empty results or errors log and return without failing the run
